# bugs #3395: mcs51: gte/pr30185.c, which passes two structs by value, fails with --stack-auto

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3395/
- Category: [Trivial fixes](../../fix-trivial.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17176
- Recommended action: Apply the patch for bug #3885, then this patch, which enables the test again, and close.
- Patch: [bugs-3395.patch](../../patches/bugs-3395.patch), commit [`642ba7635`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/642ba76351f77b2194eb5b6560f785eb3e82a095). Apply after `bugs-3885.patch`.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

`support/regression/MakeList` excludes `gte_pr30185` for mcs51-small-stack-auto and
mcs51-large-stack-auto under a comment that names this ticket. Without the exclusion the test
fails for both targets on r17158.

## Cause

`gte/pr30185.c` calls a function with two struct arguments, and with `--stack-auto` the caller
pushes each struct by value. That is the construct of bug #3885. `getFreePtr` in
`src/mcs51/gen.c` pushes r0 or r1 below the argument bytes when both registers are in use, and no
instruction removes that byte. The mechanism is described in the entry for bug #3885.

## Fix

The patch removes the two exclusions from `support/regression/MakeList`. It changes no compiler
source.

## Verification

With the patch for bug #3885 applied, `gte_pr30185` passes for mcs51-small-stack-auto and
mcs51-large-stack-auto.
